title: DevOps Portfolio Platform
description: Two-tier portfolio website deployed via GitOps to showcase skills, projects, and experience. Built end-to-end from application code to production deployment on EKS using a full platform engineering stack.
highlights: Full GitOps deployment pipeline with FluxCD pulling Helm charts from ECR
Istio service mesh for traffic routing instead of traditional NGINX ingress
Automated image scanning with Trivy in CI/CD pipeline
Python scripts for building and pushing Docker images to ECR
TLS certificates automated via cert-manager with Let's Encrypt
github: REVIEW: Add your GitHub URL once you create the repo

title: Platform Tools — Kubernetes Infrastructure Toolkit
description: Collection of production-ready Kubernetes platform tools deployed via FluxCD and Kustomize, providing observability, autoscaling, secrets management, and centralized logging for EKS clusters.
highlights: Thanos integration for long-term Prometheus metrics storage and multi-cluster querying
Sealed Secrets for GitOps-safe encrypted secret management in Kubernetes
EFK stack (Elasticsearch, Fluentd, Kibana) for centralized log aggregation
Karpenter configuration for intelligent node autoscaling on EKS
Full FluxCD GitOps setup with Kustomize overlays for environment management

title: ProjectX — Modular AWS Infrastructure with Terraform
description: Production-grade modular Terraform project that provisions a complete AWS environment from VPC networking to EKS clusters, DocumentDB databases, and application deployments with IRSA-based secrets management.
highlights: Modular Terraform architecture with separate VPC, EKS, and DocumentDB modules
GitHub Actions CI/CD with OIDC federation for keyless AWS authentication
VPC CNI prefix delegation configuration for improved pod networking density
IRSA roles with scoped secrets read policies for secure application access
Remote state management with S3 backend and DynamoDB locking

title: EKS Monitoring Stack with Thanos
description: Deployed and configured a Prometheus and Grafana monitoring stack on EKS with Thanos for long-term metrics retention and high-availability querying across clusters.
highlights: Thanos sidecar and query components for durable, scalable metrics
Custom Grafana dashboards for cluster health and workload performance
Deployed via FluxCD for GitOps-managed observability

title: Sealed Secrets for GitOps Workflows
description: Implemented Bitnami Sealed Secrets to safely store encrypted Kubernetes secrets in Git, enabling fully automated secret management within FluxCD GitOps pipelines.
highlights: Encrypted secrets committed safely to Git without exposing sensitive data
Integrated with FluxCD reconciliation for automated secret deployment
Eliminated manual kubectl secret creation from deployment workflows

title: CI/CD Pipeline Consolidation
description: Standardized deployment workflows across 8+ microservices by consolidating fragmented CI/CD pipelines into a unified GitHub Actions system at Egencia American Express.
highlights: Reduced release complexity across 8+ services into a single workflow
Improved engineering delivery speed by approximately 40%
Simplified onboarding for development teams

title: Reusable Terraform Infrastructure Modules
description: Built modular Terraform configurations to provision EKS clusters, IAM roles, and remote state infrastructure, turning multi-day environment setup into a repeatable 2-hour process.
highlights: Reduced environment provisioning time from days to ~2 hours
Reusable modules adopted across multiple teams and environments
Covered EKS clusters, IAM roles, and remote state backends

title: EFK Centralized Logging Stack
description: Deployed a centralized logging pipeline using Elasticsearch, Fluentd, and Kibana across Kubernetes clusters for structured log aggregation, search, and visualization.
highlights: Centralized log collection across staging and production namespaces
Fluentd daemonsets for node-level log forwarding to Elasticsearch
Kibana dashboards for real-time log search and troubleshooting

title: Karpenter Node Autoscaling
description: Configured Karpenter for intelligent, fast node provisioning on EKS, replacing the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler with a more responsive and cost-efficient scaling solution.
highlights: Faster node provisioning compared to Cluster Autoscaler
Provisioner specs tuned for workload-appropriate instance types
Deployed and managed via FluxCD GitOps pipeline

title: Full-Stack CI/CD Validation App
description: Built and deployed a sample Node.js/React application to validate CI/CD workflows and test microservice connectivity end to end.
highlights: Served as a proof-of-concept for the consolidated CI/CD pipeline
Validated microservice connectivity across namespaces
Used as a reference implementation for development teams
